Project Name: Bly Road Janitorial Service

Solicitation No. 1240BF26Q0026

Project Location:

Freemont-Winema National Forest

Bly Compound

6100 HWY140 East

Bly, Oregon 97622

This synopsis publicizes a forthcoming solicitation for Janitorial Services at Bly Compound Freemont-Winema National Forest. As authorized by FAR 12.201-1 Simplified procedures (c) (2) the contracting officer has chosen to solicit quotations directly from Contractors who live in Oregon.

If the physical address of your company is in  Oregon and you believe you would be a good fit of this project, please email the following to Bridgette.Jones@usda.gov.

  1. Company Name
  2. UEI SAM number
  3. Point of Contact Name
  4. Phone number
  5. Email address

The estimated solicitation issue date is April 17, 2026

Quotations will be due May 4, 2026

Quoters must be registered in www. Sam.gov by May 4, 2026
